resources.string: Bring in your runs and other activities from Garmin Connect

With your own personal API key from Garmin, Flownics brings in each activity you record (the full recording: every lap, pace, heart rate, cadence, step length) into your journal, and matches it to your plan. It only reads, and only your own account.

1. Open the key page in Garmin Connect (signed in to your account).\n2. Create Key, accept Garmin\'s terms, and choose how long it lasts (up to a year).\n3. Copy the key (Garmin shows it only once) and paste it here.

The journal syncs by itself when you open it (every few hours), from 30 days back the first time. Each activity is downloaded once; already imported ones are skipped. When the key expires, make a new one and paste it here.
The key is kept encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore), is sent only to Garmin, and isn\'t in backups. Garmin intends the personal key for your own data, not for apps serving others.
Without a key: in Garmin Connect, open an activity, ⋮, Export Original, and import the file in the journal (Import a FIT file).
